## RefreshOptions.force property

Overwrite toolkit-owned scaffold files even when their on-disk content has diverged from what the toolkit last wrote (i.e. the user edited them). Without this, diverged files are reported as conflicts and left untouched.

**Signature:**

```typescript
force?: boolean;
```
